notes.title: Drosoph Hotel Update
notes.content:
Hi Hotel Managers!

We are proud to announce that the Official Early Access "0.9.6.0" Patch is out! As we updated Unity 5 to Unity 2018, we had to reorganise and re-check everything in the game. Mythic Chest is extremely excited for this release. This release is packed full of new content, bug fixes, optimizations, and game balancing.

[previewyoutube=HNPOBcPPD1o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Official Early Access "0.9.6.0" Release Notes![/h1]

[h2]Global[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Main Menu
[*] Bloom added
[*] Cursor locked to screen
[*] Framerate limit: 60
[/list]

[h2]Story mode(Victim mode)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Speed and base stamina increased for Chris, Lizzy and John
[*] New animations: weapon handling for John
[*] Added Melee for John
[*] New weapon sounds for John
[*] Introduction to Chris
[*] New Effects to announce where you can you the Red Flask
[*] Main Characters can't see what is behind them
[*] New prompt for hiding
[*] Furniture size changes in the kitchen
[*] New dialogue interactions
[*] New messages
[*] New ambient sounds
[*] New ambient music
[*] Reworked all the lights
[*] You can see new events with the Ouija Lens
[*] Speed increased to some enemies in Lizzy part
[*] Zombies color saturation
[*] Added Zombie worker with the yellow jacket
[*] Removed some obtacles in the mine
[*] Buttons tutorials rearranged
[*] Dinner table size changes in the Dinning Room
[*] Save spots rearranged for Lizzy
[*] New Cinematics
[*] Missions
[*] Ghostly messages
[*] Monster in wheelchair in Lizzy part
[*] Crawl monster in new places
[*] Added brightness settings
[*] New video in the Movie Theatre
[*] A lot of internal fixes
[/list]
[i][b]*The Official Early Access "0.9.6.0" Patch is not compatible with previous save game data in Story Mode. We inform you that this save game data will be deleted with this update.[/b][/i]

[h2]Endless mode and Survival mode[/h2]
[list]
[*] Esc pauses the game
[*] Monster mode
[*] Brutaliser with Monster mode
[*] New animations
[*] Monsters can heal with brutaliser
[*] Monsters can sprint in monster mode
[*] Blood added when Brutaliser
[*] Store Room available since the beginning
[*] New tutorials
[*] New sounds
[*] Destroy room button available
[*] Destination of guests and monsters when you select them
[*] "Close Door" time ending reminder
[*] Closed Door shown in map
[*] Monsters patrol reworked
[*] New skins for guests
[*] New Teleport guests skill
[*] A lot of internal fixes
[/list]

[h3]For more info, follow us on social media, links below.[/h3]

notes.title: First peek of the upcoming update
notes.content:
Hey Hotel Managers, 

We want to share with you now and then some peeks of the exciting upcoming update. 

[h2]WHAT'S NEW?[/h2]

In the [b]Victim Mode[/b], the lights will be more interactive, meaning when you use the light of your phone, it won't light up behind you, for a better horror feeling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30969361/d37c91588194d7bbdb02884bea0fbab5dc520543.png[/img]

Who knows what could appear behind you now, I'm sure it won't be anything scary. *wink-wink*

notes.title: The Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Hi Hotel Managers!!! It's been awhile but we came back with a lots of things planned. We don't want to promise anything and then not provide it, but we definitely want to stay more in touch with the community, so from now on we will share, in a regular basis: images, gifs, videos and information of what we are working on. Stay tune for exciting changes we are doing to the hotel in this coming soon update.

We’re so so grateful to everyone for being extremely patient with us as we learn more ways to improve our games.

Can’t wait for you to see what we have planned for our next update!

notes.title: Story mode is here!!
notes.content:
Greeting Hotel Managers

Mythic Chest is day by day working hard on the development of Drosoph Hotel, we are very excited to announce the release of the Story mode(Victim) today.

Chris Dorsett and his wife are drawn to a mysterious hotel in Orange Pines. Solve multiple puzzles and help Chris survive in this old hotel.

[b] Key Features [/b]

[list]
    [*]Survival horror game 
    [*]Unravel the dark history of the hotel
    [*]Solve multiple puzzles
    [*]Survive a place plagued by monsters and traps
[/list]
